preconditions.description: The input graph has n vertices (1 ≤ n ≤ 500) and m edges (0 ≤ m ≤ n(n-1)/2), with no multiple edges.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= u <= n and 1 <= v <= n and u != v for u, v in edges)
preconditions.description: Each edge (u, v) connects distinct vertices within the valid range [1, n].

postconditions.description: The first line of output is 'Yes' if and only if there exists a string s of length n with characters in {'a', 'b', 'c'} such that the graph G constructed from s matches the input graph. Otherwise, output 'No'.

postconditions.expression: exists_string and len(s) == n and all(c in {'a', 'b', 'c'} for c in s)
postconditions.description: If 'Yes', the second line is a valid string s of length n composed of 'a', 'b', and 'c' that generates the input graph G.

postconditions.expression: all((i != j and (s[i-1] == s[j-1] or abs(ord(s[i-1]) - ord(s[j-1])) == 1)) == ((i, j) in edges or (j, i) in edges) for i in range(1, n+1) for j in range(1, n+1))
postconditions.description: The string s must produce the exact input graph G: edges exist if and only if the corresponding characters in s are equal or adjacent in the alphabet ('a'-'b' or 'b'-'c').
